name: Lady Byrathes
source:
Lady Byrathes is a very mysterious woman with not alot being known about her. She doesn't volunteer much information, and always seeks out information by any means possible. She is one of the 7 main lords of the Kortian Empire.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
